title: a consumer given no retry policy dead-letters a failure after one attempt, keeping every header
comment: consume without a retry argument: the library's consumer with no retry policy configured. Java (RetryPolicy.none()), Python (no_retry()) and Ruby (RetryPolicy.none) dead-letter after one attempt. Before .NET 0.7.15 and Go 0.9.11: .NET waited 5s and republished to the source queue for ever (Ack.Retry with no policy); Go republished to the source queue at once with attempt+1, without limit, under its zero policy.
x-acemq-future is AMQP-ENV-014: Python, Ruby and Go rebuilt the dead-lettered message's headers from their envelope fields before Python 0.7.14, Ruby 0.7.16 and Go 0.9.11.

steps.comment: long enough for a 5s in-consumer retry to show
